resources.string: This BimmerGestalt addon mirrors your phone navigation into the car. Share a destination from Google Maps or Waze to \"Send to car navigation\" and it starts the car\'s own navigation, which shows on the digital dash and head-up display. While Google Maps or Waze is navigating, the next turn and ETA are also shown inside the car app.
